nuclide-numbers-density.label: Distinguishes A, Z, M and number density N

isotopes-notation.label: Reads isotope notation; chemical vs. nuclear identity

nuclear-size-mass-amu.label: Relates nuclear size and mass to the carbon-12 amu

mass-defect-binding-energy.label: Relates the mass defect to binding energy

binding-per-nucleon-curve.label: Reads the B/A curve and its energy consequences

line-of-stability.label: Explains what makes a nuclide stable or unstable

sigma-area-not-size.label: Reads a cross section as a probability, not a nuclear size

macroscopic-sigma-per-path.label: Builds Sigma = N sigma and reads it per unit path length

decay-modes-and-balance.label: Predicts decay mode from instability; balances A and Z

chains-equilibrium-series.label: Reasons about decay chains and the natural series

decay-law-and-activity.label: Uses the decay law; half-life is a rate, not a lifetime

semilog-linearization-and-fit.label: Linearizes the decay law and reads lambda, t-half and A-zero off a semi-log fit

counting-statistics-and-background.label: Puts an honest uncertainty on a count: sigma = sqrt(N), background subtraction, and what the fit quality means

alara-time-distance-shielding.label: Applies ALARA - time, distance and shielding - to their own bench work

q-value-and-threshold.label: Balances a reaction; reads the Q-value sign and threshold

elastic-scattering-moderation.label: Explains why light nuclei slow neutrons and heavy ones do not
